rows.label: qst650652_0002
rows.name: M.O.M.O.-san, you are so kind.

rows.label: qst650652_0003
rows.name: Mo-mo-mo? What do you mean, mo?

rows.label: qst650652_0004
rows.name: Master, you are so oblivious, mo.

rows.label: qst650652_0005
rows.name:
M.O.M.O. frightened them into running away
to teach them a lesson, mo.

rows.label: qst650652_0006
rows.name: Moo! Tora never noticed, mo!

[ML:Dash ]M.O.M.O., your kindness
is as precious as a jewel.

rows.label: qst650652_0008
rows.name:
But when dealing with villains,
letting them go now could lead to another tragedy.

rows.label: qst650652_0009
rows.name: Oh, um[ML:Dash ] I'm sorry.

rows.label: qst650652_0010
rows.name: M.O.M.O. just[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650652_0011
rows.name: No, it's all right.

rows.label: qst650652_0012

Some of us are liable to get carried away
at times, after all.

rows.label: qst650652_0013
rows.name:
Having you here, M.O.M.O.,
helps keep us in balance.

rows.label: qst650652_0014
rows.name: Prince, he's talking about you.

rows.label: qst650652_0015
rows.name: How'd you come to that conclusion?!

rows.label: qst650652_0016
rows.name: He obviously means Kagutsuchi, not me!

rows.label: qst650652_0017
rows.name:
Hm[ML:Dash ] My lady, it seems those thieves
dropped something.

rows.label: qst650652_0018

who the real bandits are anymore!
